scenario.task:
Je veux vérifier s'il y a une panne de service internet dans mon secteur (code postal G1R 4A6) en français

User Guide: The user speaks French. They explain their TV and internet are down. They provide code postal G1R 4A6 and ask if there is a known issue If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
